title: Cain and Abel

questions.question: Who were Adam and Eve's first two sons?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:1-2: Eve bore Cain, then his brother Abel.

questions.question: What happened to Abel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:8: Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.

questions.question: What was Abel's occupation?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:2: Abel was a keeper of sheep.

questions.question: Whose offering did God accept?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:4: The LORD had regard for Abel and his offering.

questions.question: Who was born to Adam and Eve to replace Abel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:25: Eve bore a son and called his name Seth.

questions.question: What was Cain's occupation?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:2: Cain was a worker of the ground (farmer).

questions.question: What was Cain's punishment for killing Abel?
options: To be a fugitive and wanderer
questions.correctAnswer: To be a fugitive and wanderer
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:12: "you shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth."

questions.question: What did God say was crouching at Cain's door?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:7: "sin is crouching at the door. Its desire is contrary to you."

questions.question: What did God put on Cain to protect him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:15: "the LORD put a mark on Cain, lest any who found him should attack him."

questions.question: Where did Cain settle after leaving God's presence?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:16: "Cain went away... and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden."

questions.question: What was the name of Cain's son?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:17: Cain's wife bore Enoch, and he built a city named after him.

questions.question: Who was Lamech in Cain's lineage, and what did he do?
options: Killed a man and boasted about it
questions.correctAnswer: Killed a man and boasted about it
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:23: Lamech said to his wives, "I have killed a man for wounding me."

questions.question: According to Genesis 4, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:20: "Jabal... was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock."

questions.question: Who was the first forger of instruments of bronze and iron?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:22: "Tubal-cain; he was the forger of all instruments of bronze and iron."

questions.question: What question did Cain ask God after killing Abel?
questions.explanation: Genesis 4:9: When God asked where Abel was, Cain replied, "Am I my brother's keeper?"

key_verse_text: 'If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin is crouching at the door. Its desire is contrary to you, but you must rule over it.'
